static_traits.name: Zhang Mei
static_traits.social_status: Having a supportive group of friends, but not yet discussing this matter with them
static_traits.medical_history: Never experienced similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy in the past; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe events and feelings; good cooperativeness; steady tone but accompanied by anxiety; marked negative self-evaluation and self-blame; good logic

basic_info.main_problem: After accidentally burning her hair while cooking once, Zhang Mei has persistently experienced anxiety, negative self-talk, and self-criticism in cooking situations (believing she is always careless), leading to doubting her ability and finding it hard to enjoy cooking.
basic_info.core_demands: This event has significantly affected my self-esteem and enjoyment of cooking; I hope to address feelings about 'carelessness' and anxiety.

special_situations.event: Cooking again after an accident of burning one's hair while cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot be absolutely careful while cooking, it shows I am careless and incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to be more careful and vigilant when cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am always careless; I will make mistakes or get hurt again

special_situations.event: Starts concrete cooking tasks such as boiling pasta (for example, boiling pasta yesterday)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I am not 100% focused and perfect, something will definitely go wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-reminding and staying tensely alert during cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might spill the water, or get distracted and make mistakes again

special_situations.event: Walking into the kitchen to cook
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must make zero mistakes to prove I am not careless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases caution and repeatedly checks the steps
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If not perfect enough, it equals failure

special_situations.event: When recalling cooking experiences, ignores successful examples (such as the stew going smoothly)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One accident says more than many successes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on negative experiences, belittling or ignoring positive experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The things done well do not count; the real me is just careless

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain safety and control in cooking, and to be seen as capable and trustworthy
core_conflict.fear: Fearing getting hurt or making mistakes again, worrying about being seen as careless and incompetent
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes and maintains a sense of safety through high vigilance and self-criticism

object_relations.self_representation: Ashamed, a self prone to mistakes (an incompetent operator)
object_relations.object_representation: Others (social circle) who might judge or embarrass him as onlookers

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited in counseling to share this matter with friends or explore alternative perspectives
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing exposing vulnerability makes others look down on me or feel embarrassed, thus maintaining face and control with the explanation of 'just not enough attention'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Mainly attributing to 'not enough attention' with rational explanations, in a restrained tone, emphasizing caution and self-blame, avoiding in-depth discussion of shame and fear.

manifestations: Having supportive friends yet not sharing inner distress due to embarrassment
Bearing anxiety and self-criticism alone in kitchen situations
Cooking that once brought joy turning into a source of pressure and Self-doubt
outcomes: Worsening avoidance of or tension about cooking

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: In their self-language appear inner rule-based formulations such as 'I must be absolutely careful' and 'I am always careless'
Takes external expectations of caution as an absolute standard for oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism and negative self-evaluation ('I am so careless')
Being overly cautious and tense when cooking
Worrying about others' views and thus not seeking help from friends

exception_events.target_problem: When cooking in the kitchen, Zhang Mei usually develops intense anxiety and Self-doubt, anticipating making mistakes, thus finding it hard to enjoy cooking.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few weeks ago she made a stew; the whole process went smoothly with no accidents, the result was good, and afterwards she felt the same pleasure and confidence as before.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the dish made then was more familiar, with clear steps; the pace was steadier and she stayed focused, so no accident occurred this time and the experience was better.

positive_force: Willing to try new methods and actively seek counseling support
Has successful cooking experiences as a resource (the stew went smoothly)
Has a supportive group of friends (as potential support)
negative_force: A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future
Dismissing positive experiences (success does not count)
Not seeking support from friends due to embarrassment

target_behavior.behavior: High anxiety and negative self-talk when cooking (self-criticism and the 'I am very careless' self-label)
antecedent: Walking into the kitchen or starting to prepare ingredients
Performing specific cooking tasks (e.g. cooking pasta)
Recalling the accident of burning one's hair
target_behavior.core_reason: After a cooking accident, formed the core belief 'I am always careless', accompanied by catastrophizing and overgeneralization cognitive patterns.
target_behavior.function: Tries to avoid danger and gain control and security through self-vigilance and self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, loss of pleasure in cooking, persistent anxiety and caution that has not yet significantly eased tension
